title: Ping-Pong (cross-machine)
description: Two-org ping-pong over the peer network. The n1-hosted Pong Corp owns the public register and starts the exchange; local-hosted Ping Labs replies. Register ownership sits on the public node so the NAT'd peer pulls towards it.
author: Sorcha Team

template.title: Ping-Pong (cross-machine)
template.description: Pong Corp (n1) starts, Ping Labs (local) replies, repeat. The starting action sits on the register-owning node so pulls happen in the NAT-friendly direction.

participants.name: Pong
participants.description: n1-side participant (register owner). Starts each round.

participants.name: Ping
participants.description: Local-side participant. Replies after pulling the transaction from n1.

actions.title: Pong
actions.description: Pong Corp (n1) sends a counter-incrementing message to Ping Labs.

routes.description: Forward to Ping Labs on the NAT'd node

actions.title: Ping
actions.description: Ping Labs (local) replies to Pong Corp, optionally bouncing back for another round.

routes.description: Loop back to Pong Corp for another round
